summary: Every shell owner that asks the immune gate for a bounded repair now passes its own probe facts (supervisor absent or on another release, HTTP/ADB/sshd/Slack probe result, ADB readiness reason) instead of the bare default observation.
reason: S24 26/10: 18 of 37 successful Sol decisions answered 'undetermined, no diagnostic details' because immune-action.sh never forwarded an observation; adb_watchdog and remote_watchdog stayed down after deploy 9527b700 while their restore waited on a decision that could not be made.

tests.name: installer/termux-lite/test-immune-action.py
tests.evidence: 7 tests; new: IMMUNE_OBSERVATION reaches allow as --observation with the supervisor facts, and a caller without facts keeps the default. Real immune-action.sh, synthetic admission port.

tests.name: health, watchdog and incident suites
tests.evidence: 23 suites that source or assert these owners pass, including test-adb-recovery-readiness-watchdog.sh, test-incident-runtime-hardening.sh, test-health-restart-escalation.py, test-supervisor-lock-portability.py, test-tier0-control.py.

tests.name: secret filter
tests.evidence: Every new observation text checked against the playbooks SECRET_RE: no match, so the gate never refuses it as unsafe context.

capabilities.reason: Evidence passed to the existing immune decision only; same operations, callbacks, budgets and verifiers.

architecture.reason: Same admission adapter and owners; one optional environment value forwarded to the existing --observation argument.

evidence: Read-only assessment: no MCP schema, adapter, endpoint or runtime protocol changed.

limitations: Full canonical CI on the final GitHub head remains required.
Live proof requires companion-deploy, then adb_watchdog and remote_watchdog restored through an accepted decision (or escalated once by the existing review).
rollback: Revert this commit; owners fall back to the default observation.
